## samb-p02-v13 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** How do the many reach unity?

**Premises.**
- Abiding in that-one-reflection (tadekāmarśavarti), by one-word-superimposition force (ekaśabdādhyāsavaśāt).
- The many (anekaḥ) too would go (vrajet) to unity (ekatām) — as pot-cloth (ghaṭapaṭau) means (iti).
- Prose: dvandva discussed at length — one reflection makes one word, one word one thing.

**Inference.** Many reach oneness through one-word superimposition — 'pot-cloth'.
